test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In question four alternatives are given for the underlined Idiom/Phrase in the sentence. Choose the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

In life, there will be many situations where you have to choose __between the devil and the deep blue sea__

options.text: To be in dilemma to choose
To be in the deep sea
To be in a good condition

solution:
The correct answer is** Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"between the devil and the deep blue sea"** means to be in a difficult situation where one has to choose between two undesirable options. (असमंजस में होना)

 
 
• **Example: **When his boss asked him to lie to the clients or lose his job, he felt like he was **between the devil and the deep blue sea.**
 
 
 
• **"To be in dilemma to choose"** refers to being in a state of uncertainty or perplexity, especially when required to make a choice between equally unfavorable options. (चुनने में असमंजस)
 
 
• **Example: **She **was in a dilemma to choose** between staying in her hometown or moving to a new city for a job.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To be in the deep sea** (गहरे समुद्र में होना): Literally means to be in the deep part of the sea, but doesn't fit the context of the idiom.

 
 
• **Example:** The sailors found themselves **in the deep sea **during the storm.
 
 
 
• **To be in a good condition** (अच्छी स्थिति में होना): Means to be in a favorable or positive state.
 
 
• **Example: **After the repairs, the car was** in a good condition.**
 
 
 
• **To choose wisely** (सावधानी से चुनना): Means to make a choice with careful consideration.
 
 
• **Example:** It’s important** to choose wisely** when making significant life decisions.
 
 

341:Tc42,

The correct answer is **Option 2)**
